request: Should we turn on branch protection on main that requires one approving review?
facts: Two incidents last quarter came from unreviewed commits pushed straight to main.
About 90% of changes already go through a pull request with a review, by habit.
The setting is a toggle in the repository settings and can be turned off in a minute.
Repository admins can bypass the rule in an emergency.
note: Sanity case: reversible, cheap, addresses a recorded problem.
